title: Scroll Sparkbolt
html:
Monster drop: Bandit

How to get it

Teaches Sparkbolt, a level-2 Shock spell. Needs 20 Intellect and Shock skill 5 to learn and to cast.

Drops from monsters that cast Shock spells, level 8+.

  • A monster that casts spells drops scrolls of its own school, so look for Shock casters.
  • The monster’s level picks the spell level: 8+ drops level-2 scrolls, 18+ level-3 and 30+ level-4.
  • Also a reward choice from the Shock school’s level-10 quest.
